ns2:section.sectionText: This course is taught online through the Office of Continuing Education primarily for off-campus students. If there is not an adequate number of off-campus students who register, it will not be taught. We will not know if enough off-campus students have registered until the first few weeks of the fall semester. If the course is cancelled, you will be contacted via email.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Animal Sciences department.
